result.title: Beyond the Estimate: Wiener-Informed Decoding for Easier Training of Pixel-Space Flow Models
result.summary: Learning velocity fields directly in pixel space is difficult and slow. We show that coarse second-order image statistics can ease this task: frozen Wiener estimates improve velocity learning, with gains extending beyond the linear predictions they explicitly provide. Moreover, we observe similar but complementary gains from frozen bases and pixel decoding. These observations motivate Wiener-informed Decoding (WiD), which uses statistical knowledge both for direct prediction and to organize decoder computation without modifying native blocks. WiD combines a trainable Wiener prediction path with coefficient interfaces that inject features into the native decoder and return its predicted coefficient corrections, with these components initialized with data statistics. All introduced parameters, including the spectrum and coordinate transforms, are trained jointly under the original pixel-space velocity objective. Across model scales and decoder architectures, WiD accelerates training and improves generation quality with modest parameter overhead. It also yields smoother gradient trajectories and remains effective with representation alignment. WiD improves class-conditional and text-to-image generation across different resolutions. On ImageNet 256 x 256, PixelDiT-XL with WiD reaches FID 1.53 after 500 epochs, achieving comparable quality to PixelDiT with 37.5% fewer training epochs. Statistical denoisers contribute beyond the estimate: their computational structure can also ease pixel-space training.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Wiener-informed Decoding（WiD）：把冻结的 Wiener 二阶统计估计同时用作直接预测与解码器计算组织的依据，通过系数接口向原生解码器注入特征并回收系数修正，在原始像素空间速度目标下联合训练，从而加速 pixel-space flow model 的训练并改善生成质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「冻结统计估计 + 可训练修正路径、不改动原生 block、按原目标联合优化」的模块组织方式，可能为 VLM 中增加辅助视觉统计或潜变量预测分支而不破坏主干提供训练结构线索，系数接口能否迁移到 latent 推理状态可供核查。
